Q1.decision: Collapsed by default: one-line tool chip; click header to expand full body.
Q1.question: Default tool density?
Q1.rec: Collapsed by default: one-line tool chip; click header to expand full body.

Q2.decision: No turn-level tool accordion in v1; per-tool compact rows only. Revisit if still too tall.
Q2.question: Group all tools since last user message into one “N tools” accordion?
Q2.rec: No turn-level tool accordion in v1; per-tool compact rows only. Revisit if still too tall.

Q3.decision: Expand all / collapse all control in transcript toolbar near session actions.
Q3.question: Expand-all control placement?
Q3.rec: Expand all / collapse all control in transcript toolbar near session actions.

Q4.decision: Remember expand-default in localStorage first; promote to Settings key only if needed.
Q4.question: Persist “tools expanded by default”?
Q4.rec: Remember expand-default in localStorage first; promote to Settings key only if needed.

Q5.decision: Same calendar day: time only (locale). Else short date + time. Full ISO in title tooltip.
Q5.question: Timestamp display format?
Q5.rec: Same calendar day: time only (locale). Else short date + time. Full ISO in title tooltip.

Q6.decision: Yes — subtle timestamp on compact tool header as well as user/assistant.
Q6.question: Show timestamps on tool rows too?
Q6.rec: Yes — subtle timestamp on compact tool header as well as user/assistant.

Q7.decision: Both: keep ADR-0010 turn card; add one live “⋯ thinking / running tool” line above it while busy.
Q7.question: Thinking status: in-transcript line vs only turn card?
Q7.rec: Both: keep ADR-0010 turn card; add one live “⋯ thinking / running tool” line above it while busy.

Q8.decision: Yes, persist thinking but collapse in history like tool calls, expand all button expands thinking too while clicking on a single thinking line only expands that line
Q8.question: Persist thinking lines after the turn ends?
Q8.rec: Ephemeral only — remove thinking line when turn goes idle; do not persist to MD or message list.

Q9.decision: Keep harness advisory bubbles as today; only phase/tool noise uses the ephemeral status line.
Q9.question: Demote harness advisories into the status strip?
Q9.rec: Keep harness advisory bubbles as today; only phase/tool noise uses the ephemeral status line.

Q10.decision: Always show attachment/image chips on tool rows even when body is collapsed.
Q10.question: Screenshots on collapsed tool rows?
Q10.rec: Always show attachment/image chips on tool rows even when body is collapsed.
